inferenceModes.onlineDescription: Generate audio on the server. Please note that each audio generation requires an internet connection and may incur related network charges.
inferenceModes.offlineDescription: No internet connection required. Compute and generate audio directly on the device. Please note that downloading or updating models still requires an internet connection, and the device needs sufficient storage space.
inferenceModes.lightweightDescription: Quickly generate audio on the device in a lightweight manner, with quality inferior to the other two modes. Suitable for devices with less memory. Only recommended when offline mode fails multiple times. Please note that this mode still requires storage space.

about.title: About
about.intro: Welcome to the Hong Kong Wai Tau Waa and Hakka Text-to-Speech (TTS) reader!
about.heritage: Wai Tau Waa and Hakka are both intangible cultural heritage of Hong Kong. However, the transmission of these indigenous languages has been disrupted due to urbanization. The new generation in walled villages has little opportunity to encounter Wai Tau Waa and Hakka, or they "can understand but cannot speak."
about.purpose: Using this Text-to-Speech (<abbr>TTS</abbr>) reader can serve as a resource for learning Wai Tau Waa and Hakka, and can also become a tool for communicating with village elders, continuing the language transmission within families and communities.

instructions.intro: Simply enter text in the program, and it will generate natural and fluent Wai Tau Waa or Hakka speech. Instructions:
instructions.step1: Select language: Wai Tau Waa / Hakka
instructions.step3: Enter text in the input box

about.credits: This program is developed by Hong Kong Indigenous Language Preservation Association. We would like to thank the Leisure and Cultural Services Department's Intangible Cultural Heritage Funding Scheme for funding this project, and the Centre for Research in Linguistics and Language Sciences, The Education University of Hong Kong for providing venue rental assistance.
about.technical: The frontend of this program is developed using TypeScript and React framework, utilizing the VITS2 language model [1] provided by hon9kon9ize. For details, please refer to the source code.
about.contact: For any inquiries, please email info@hkilang.org or lchaakming@eduhk.hk.
